did_you_know.text: The Black Panther Party is created by Huey P. Newton and Bobby Seale.

did_you_know.title: Million Man March
did_you_know.text: Hundreds of thousands of Black men gathered on the National Mall in Washington D.C. for the Million Man March, one of the largest demonstrations in American history.

did_you_know.title: Tommie Smith & John Carlos Black Power Salute
did_you_know.text: At the 1968 Mexico City Olympics, sprinters Tommie Smith and John Carlos raised their fists in a Black Power salute on the medal podium — an image that defined an era.
